high_contrast.description: changes platform fill to #2c3d70, edge to #ffffff, and perfect zone to #ffe66d

reduced_motion.description: reduces particle burst count and power by half, and halves feedback_scale for camera_kick and flash

layout.thumb_zone_considerations: critical interactive elements (retry, share, skin, settings) are placed in the lower half and within easy thumb reach
layout.ui_anchoring: full_rect with anchors set to preserve aspect ratio on different screen sizes via Godot's canvas_items stretch mode

responsive_behavior.aspect_ratio_handling: the game scales uniformly to fit the screen while maintaining the base aspect ratio, with potential black bars on devices with different aspect ratios
responsive_behavior.ui_scaling: UI elements are positioned and sized relative to the base resolution and scale with the stretch mode

typography.font: default Godot font (can be replaced with a licensed alternative if needed, but for now use the built-in)

visual_direction.silhouette_emphasis: strong player and platform silhouettes against dark background
visual_direction.visual_noise: minimal around landing targets (perfect zone and platform edges)
